title: Deterministic Spectral Emergence Test
statement: Across real-world chaotic datasets, windowed spectral analysis reveals a persistent alpha exponent significantly distinct from null models and stable under bootstrap perturbations.

expected_result.note: Tightened bounds to enforce real invariance

falsification.condition: If alpha falls outside [0.5,3.5] OR sigma > 1.2 OR cross-domain variance > 0.8
